The '''Protective Whirlwind ''' is a weave in the [[One Power]], it is formed mainly by flows of Air. It was used by [[Alise]], linked to others [[Kinswomen]], to protect Queen [[Elayne]] when she took possession of the Kingdom of [[Cairhien]]. It was conceived specifically after a request by [[Birgitte]] to repel arrow attacks from a distance, when the Queen was on a open ground outside the city walls.
